title: Onboard Orion-7B v1: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Maya Chen
description: Onboard the community-contributed Orion-7B v1 model into the model registry with full metadata, performance profiles for common inference shapes, and automated changelog/release-note generation when model entries or perf profiles change. Motivation: Orion-7B provides a competitive latency/quality tradeoff for mid-tier production workloads; adding it to the registry allows Redwood users to select it with calibrated perf profiles and ensures changes are traceable via changelog automation. Changes include: 1) models/orion-7b-v1/metadata.json (model card, license, tokenizer spec, recommended quantization); 2) performance_profiles/orion-7b-v1.yaml (profiles for 128/256/512 token contexts with measured throughput/latency and memory footprint on g4dn and a100); 3) scripts/changelog-generator.py and CI job to append human-readable release notes to registry changelog when model metadata or perf profiles change; 4) registry schema migration helpers (schema v2 -> v3) and validation tests; 5) docs: registry.md updated with onboarding checklist and perf guidance. Checklist: - [x] metadata validated against schema v3 - [x] perf profiles generated from benchmark-lab runs - [x] changelog automation added (dry-run) - [x] unit/integration tests - [x] docs updated - [x] security review (license confirmed). Related: ENG-4821 (onboarding cadence), PM-1023 (catalog expansion). This PR intentionally keeps the perf profiles conservative (measured med/95th lat and 99th for tails) and includes notes on recommended rollout: start canary on Dedicated with 10% traffic and monitor quality/regressions.

release_notes: Onboarded Orion-7B v1 to model registry; added performance profiles for 128/256/512 token contexts (measured on g4dn and a100); added changelog automation to generate registry release notes on model/profile changes; updated registry schema to v3 and migration helper included; docs updated with onboarding checklist and rollout guidance.
notes: Perf profiles are conservative; recommend canary rollout and validation against downstream evals. The changelog-generator supports a dry-run mode to preview entries and is gated behind a CI job to avoid noisy commits. Schema migration preserves v2 fields and adds 'quantization_recommendations' as an optional field.
